gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis: Patients with a preoperative diagnosis of a suspected high-grade glioma based demographics and MRI imaging.
Group 1: Suspected high-grade glioma with contrast enhancement on MRI (GBM-like).

gbm_population_flag.reason: Population is suspected high-grade glioma; 'GBM-like' (and 'GMB like' in the arm label) describes an MRI enhancement phenotype, not a glioblastoma diagnosis requirement; adjudicator may judge this as naming glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] KINEVO 900 S with BLUE 400 (other names: CALLAO)
5-ALA Administration: Patients who will receive 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) for fluorescence guidance during surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No Prior Treatment: Patients who have not received prior treatment for the current brain tumor, including surgery, radiotherapy, or chemotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: 5-ALA Administration: Patients who will receive 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) for fluorescence guidance during surgery.

coder_notes: Observational-type imaging device study (Phase NA). 5-ALA is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it for fluorescence guidance (listed per R9 as diagnostic_agent). Single registered arm 'GMB like or LGG like' (typo in registry). Contrast enhancement groups are imaging phenotypes, not molecular biomarkers.
